environment: empty HOME, explicit Cargo/Rustup paths; ROM_DIR points to fetched ROMs; two jobs and nice -n 10

commands.name: wasm-clippy
commands.command: nice -n 10 cargo +1.99.0 clippy --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p esp32sim-wasm --features jit-tests -j2 -- -D warnings

commands.name: virtual-quantum
commands.command: ESP32SIM_VQ_NATIVE=1 nice -n 10 cargo +1.99.0 test --release -p esp32s3 -j2 --test machine --test virtual_stops

commands.name: wasm-demos
commands.command: ESP32SIM_ROM_DIR="$ROM_DIR" node tools/wasm-test.mjs hello c3-hello c6-hello c6-energy-scan c6-contiki c6-contiki-net c6-rpl-net panel tdisplay-prices

commands.name: wasm-abi
commands.command: node wasm/tests/timing-api.mjs web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm && node wasm/tests/ble-api.mjs web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm web/wasm/fw/public $ROM_DIR/esp32c3_rev3_rom.elf && node wasm/tests/ble-connection.mjs web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm web/wasm/fw/public $ROM_DIR/esp32c3_rev3_rom.elf

commands.name: worker
commands.command: node tools/worker-pacing-test.mjs && node tools/worker-channel-test.mjs && node --test tools/touch-input-test.mjs

commands.name: browser-contracts
commands.command: node --test tools/wasm-build-policy.test.mjs && node --test tools/browser-benchmark/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/browser-benchmark -p 'test_*.py'

commands.name: retained-receipts
commands.command: node --test docs/evidence/perf-x5-2026-09-22/verify-results.test.mjs && node docs/evidence/perf-x5-2026-09-22/verify-results.mjs && node --test docs/evidence/perf-x5-2026-09-22/m1-before-after/verify.test.mjs && node docs/evidence/perf-x5-2026-09-22/m1-before-after/verify.mjs && node --test docs/evidence/perf-x5-2026-09-22/historical-before-after/verify.test.mjs && node docs/evidence/perf-x5-2026-09-22/historical-before-after/verify.mjs

commands.name: wasm-profile
commands.command: nice -n 10 sh -c ". ./tools/wasm-rustflags.sh; cargo +1.99.0 build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p esp32sim-wasm --features jit-profile,cpu-profile -j2"
